overview: From 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05, ethereum-optimism/optimism had 2 new PRs (4 merged), 0 new issues, and 9 active contributors.

topPRs.title: kona-node: stop derivation when pipeline signals fail
topPRs.author: einar-oplabs
topPRs.body:
A failed pipeline reset is currently acknowledged as processed, so derivation can resume using retained stage data after SafeDB has already been truncated. Failed signals now propagate to the service supervisor before acknowledgment, head adoption, or payload submission, preventing that partially reset state from serving new history.

Any failed pipeline signal, including a temporary reset RPC failure, stops the node. This favors correct history over continuing from an unconfirmed pipeline state; automatic retry would require retaining the failed signal and gating derivation until it succeeds.

Related: https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/23473. Acceptance/documentation is in #23787; additional mixed-node parity validation is in #23818.

- [x] Temporary and critical reset-error actor regressions fail without the fix and pass with it, forbidding stale payload/finalization submission.
- [x] Two-actor service-supervisor/RPC tests pass for both errors: RPC responds before injection, the original error reaches the production supervisor, cancellation fires, and the server stops. Both fail with propagation removed.
- [x] All 252 node-service unit tests pass locally, with zero skips.
- [x] Targeted clippy and pinned-nightly formatting pass; Rust and SafeDB reviews have no findings.
- [x] All 121 CI checks pass for the signed shutdown-test commit `55202491e4`, with zero failures or pending checks.
- [ ] Human approval and merge.

The shutdown tests exercise the production supervisor and RPC actor with a real HTTP endpoint, not a full rollup topology with an injected L1/provider failure. No review findings were dismissed.

topPRs.title: contracts-bedrock: Fail closed on zero delays in OptimismPortal2 and AnchorStateRegistry
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
U22 moves the proof maturity delay and the dispute game finality delay from immutables to storage. A bare `ProxyAdmin.upgrade` without `initialize` leaves these slots at zero. Before this PR, `OptimismPortal2` and `AnchorStateRegistry` read a zero as "no delay". Withdrawals and games could then finalize with no review period. `DelayedWETH` already fails closed in this case (U22-AI-1DW-01).

This PR contains the changes from ethereum-optimism/optimism#23867 and adds the portal guard. Now `AnchorStateRegistry.isGameFinalized` returns false and `OptimismPortal2.checkWithdrawal` reverts when its delay is zero. The two delays use separate storage slots in separate contracts, so the ASR guard does not cover a portal upgraded alone. The proof maturity delay is also the only delay that protects against an incorrectly proven withdrawal against a valid, finalized game.

The guards check `== 0`, not `< MIN`. A later increase of the minimum therefore cannot freeze a chain that stores a lower value. The L1 ProxyAdmin owner can recover a chain with the setters. Correctly initialized chains see no change. The portal reuses `OptimismPortal_ProofNotOldEnough` and its ABI does not change.

The PR also fixes two ASR fuzz tests that never reached the delay check (U22-AI-1DW-03).

topPRs.title: contracts-bedrock: address U22 AI audit 1DW findings
topPRs.author: zkfrov
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Remediates the 1DW findings from the U22 internal AI audit. The only contract change is to `AnchorStateRegistry`; the matching spec changes are in ethereum-optimism/specs#984.

| Finding | Severity | Remediation |
|---|---|---|
| `U22-AI-1DW-01` | Low | `isGameFinalized` returns false when the finality delay is zero, as on a proxy upgraded without calling `initialize`. Matches the existing guard in `DelayedWETH`. Specified in specs#984. |
| `U22-AI-1DW-02` | Info | No code change: `checkWithdrawal` keeps its strict proof maturity check. The spec now states that a withdrawal must be proven more than `proofMaturityDelaySeconds` ago ([specs#984](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/984)). |
| `U22-AI-1DW-03` | Info | Fixed two fuzz tests that never reached the delay check, and renamed them. |

topPRs.title: contracts-bedrock: make the Burn.Gas invariant detect an under-burn
topPRs.author: 0xOneTony
topPRs.body:
## Details

**Root cause**

Reversed unchecked subtraction wraps to ~2^256 and the conjunction never sets the failure flag. Pre-existing test defect (file unchanged from both bases); `Burn.gas` is the fee-burn primitive used by `ResourceMetering._metered`.

**Verifier** (CONFIRMED, confidence high)

- Mutation experiment reproduced (compile confirmed by artifact hash): `invariant_burn_gas` passes 64 runs / 32,000 calls with `Burn.gas` burning nothing while the control fails (154 < 100,000); both pass restored.
- Predicate is doubly unreachable; no other test asserts the burn amount.
- Pre-existing since 2023.
- Convention ruling: tracker row at info because `invariant_burn_gas` is the ONLY pin on the deposit resource-fee burn (`ResourceMetering._metered` via `Burn.gas`) and its predicate can never fire; never a Cantina known issue.
